scope: Preserved #466 baseline findings with #467 implementation resolutions; final author visual/attribution acceptance remains pending.

findings.evidence: Native failures without palette and episode; diagnostic grayscale palette plus episode permits initialization without a commercial IWAD.
findings.decision: Provide project bootstrap metadata and an independently generated compatibility palette in #467; retain true-color artwork and existing gameplay data.
findings.resolution: Implemented by independent bootstrap/resources/voice configuration or filtered build_release.py; native and static evidence in assets/validation_v5_18_1. Original baseline evidence above is retained.

findings.evidence: Explicit projectile states, inherited BulletPuff and MODELDEF bindings; all four textures absent in native standalone probe.
findings.decision: Supply owned replacement impact frames while preserving state names/timing/model bindings; no damage or collision change.
findings.resolution: Implemented by independent bootstrap/resources/voice configuration or filtered build_release.py; native and static evidence in assets/validation_v5_18_1. Original baseline evidence above is retained.

findings.decision: Retain blood behavior with owned frames; no dependency on commercial blood sprites. Verify native default and active effects in #467.
findings.resolution: Implemented by independent bootstrap/resources/voice configuration or filtered build_release.py; native and static evidence in assets/validation_v5_18_1. Original baseline evidence above is retained.

findings.decision: Provide a project-owned sky-marker flat and verify actual sky rendering; the lookup alone does not establish a visible defect.
findings.resolution: Implemented by independent bootstrap/resources/voice configuration or filtered build_release.py; native and static evidence in assets/validation_v5_18_1. Original baseline evidence above is retained.

findings.decision: Resolve inherited aliases using retained project recordings/native handling in #467; preserve Rulo's silent combat-pain contract and voice selection. Verify actual events, not just alias declarations.

findings.evidence: The authoritative map catalogue marks these five retained maps as kind=test.
findings.decision: Exclude their WAD members from the independent distribution, retain source files and development packages; no file deletion.
findings.resolution: Implemented by independent bootstrap/resources/voice configuration or filtered build_release.py; native and static evidence in assets/validation_v5_18_1. Original baseline evidence above is retained.

findings.evidence: Native bootstrap reports optional OPL playback unavailable. All 131 project recordings are OGG, MP3 or WAV; no MIDI runtime music.
findings.decision: Do not include Doom GENMIDI. Document unused optional OPL capability; verify retained streamed audio under #467/#468.
findings.resolution: Unused optional OPL remains excluded; streamed project recordings retain their original bytes.
